settings.heading: Apiarian (adj.): relating to bees or beekeeping. Home (n.): the place we care for, in our surroundings, and in ourselves.

settings.text:
Hello! I'm Netta, a beekeeper and apitherapist based in Fort Collins, Colorado. Apiarian Home is my small-batch studio for products and services inspired by, and made with help from, the beloved honeybee. Everything is built with respect for the hive, and make to bring a little more healing energy and beauty into everyday life through their magic and medicine.

To start, we're launching with a collection of five home fragrances, each one crafted around a role in the hive. I'm so grateful to share these with you and bring the therapeutic scents of nature into your home.
